She holds a brown tabby cat and uses small white scissors to carefully clip its front claws. The background features a wooden shelf and a white wall. (2) The scene cuts to her holding a calico cat in the same position, continuing the clipping motion. She looks concentrated, with her mouth slightly open. (3) Another cut shows her holding a ginger tabby cat, performing the same action. The lighting remains consistent and bright. (4) The woman is now holding a young boy in a black t-shirt. She uses the scissors on his fingers while he makes exaggerated, wide-eyed facial expressions and smiles. (5) She holds a younger toddler in a beige and brown shirt, using the scissors on him as well. The toddler looks curious and touches the scissors. (6) The woman holds up a pair of large industrial yellow wire cutters toward the camera. A man in a black t-shirt enters the frame; she chases him out of the room playfully with the cutters. (7) A final shot shows the older boy walking across a foam mat in the living room toward the camera while talking.
